$comment: Logical Space/Community control state. A Space organizes independent children; it is not a conversation or MLS roster.

SpaceControlState.membership: typed principals and assigned role IDs
SpaceControlState.child_links: Room/Publication/Space affiliations with visibility and bilateral-link evidence
SpaceControlState.governance: principals/threshold/delegation policy authorized to advance Space control state

Rule: Space membership/linking does not silently create Room membership, MLS membership or child authority. Official child affiliation is bilateral.

SpaceControlTransition.authorization: evidence satisfying the previous state governance/policy

ControlConflictRule: Two otherwise valid authority-changing successors of one parent do not resolve by timestamp/provider arrival. Privileged advancement freezes until a resolution referencing competing heads is authorized under the common pre-fork governance.
PrivacyRule: Public catalog state may be signed/public. Private membership/role/organization state is E2EE-distributed to authorized recipients; exact selective-disclosure/traffic-analysis resistance is a separate metadata gate.
